notes.title: Terletski Games presents: The New Game!
notes.content:
A new game by Vitalii Terletskii, co-creator of Alt Girl for Skoof!


For the first time in its history, the totalitarian nation of Sobakistan is opening its borders.
The occasion? A grand rehearsal for the funeral of the Supreme Leader, Comrade Buddy. Everything must be flawless: the canine army is scrubbing the streets, journalists have been carefully selected, and the population has been warned.



You are one of the few allowed in.



Sobakistan: The Land of Dogs is a darkly satirical narrative game set in a sealed-off state ruled entirely by intelligent dogs. The story unfolds through dialogue, hidden details, and a gradual shift between six playable characters — each with their own view of the same terrifying world.

No freedom of choice.
No objective truth.
Just a documentary assignment, a pixelated surveillance device, and the creeping feeling that someone is already watching you.

Wishlist it now!
Glory to Sobakistan.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950025/85ef4d3c520a3c2c5a9dc5a0e2c7e67a40fa8d1d.png"]


🎮 Key Features:
A rich, hand-crafted world and deep story based on the acclaimed comic of the same name

Six playable characters, each with a unique perspective

Choices with consequences, leading to multiple endings

Full immersion in a totalitarian atmosphere

Puzzle-solving, stealth elements, and item collection

Retro aesthetics with in-universe narrative justification

Meta- and 4D-narrative mechanics (some may surprise you)

Created by the original comic’s authors: Vitalii Terletskii and Katya

Original soundtrack by Pasha Zhdanov (Ada) and Pazetic Ocean

notes.title: The workshop "An alt girl for skoof" is open!
notes.content:
We are pleased to announce that the Mod Workshop is officially open.

We have written rules and minimal guidance.
You can read them here, we also duplicate them in the post.

Official rules for creating mods

0. The official test mod, which you can use as a template, is here. As a sign of respect to the creators of Renpy, we placed the engine's mascot in our game - Eileen. Moreover, it was drawn by both RIKANI and Vitaly Terletsky, thus showing that anyone can do fashion.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44950025/8ab847f633b1dc763b0e674f390c0a4af3c16583.jpg

1. The modding functionality currently supports the creation of your own alts, which can be found at the moment you select the game.

2. Right now we don't have time to write a big official guide, but you will need basic knowledge of the Renpy engine. For now, you can refer to the guide of the friendly game "Herbalist"

3. The following are prohibited in mods: nudity, images of a sexual nature and any information that contradicts the legislation of the Russian Federation. Mods with such content will be deleted.

If any of the users writes a comprehensive guide to creating mods for the "Altushka for Skuf", we will be happy to publish it officially

We are looking forward to the fan version of altushki.
Sincerely yours,
Vitalii Terletskii and RIKANI

notes.title: DLC ANNOUNCEMENT: An Alt girl for Skoof - More, more!
notes.content:
A big DLC addition is planned for release in the second half of July. Add to your wishlist on Steam so you don’t miss the release!

What awaits you:

- Three new Altushkas - Nyusha, Lisa and Kira, each with a unique story
- Altushki is voiced by Alina Rin, Persona 99 and Albina Seksova
- Already includes full voice acting of all characters from Prophet Sunboy
- Completion time is no less than that of the main part of the game
- 9 (nine) new endings (if we haven’t mixed anything up)
- Mini-games with trickы
- Significant development of the plot and universe of the game

Add-on price: $2.49, for the game you will need the main part, which, by the way, is now on sale on Steam with a discount 50%.

The game is in post-production stage, the wait won't be long!
Subscribe to our social networks to be the first to know about all the news
